name: PasteQueue — copy several, paste in order
description: A clipboard queue: load it with several copies, arm it, then Ctrl+V pastes them back one by one, in order.

capture-selection.description: Add the current selection to the queue

paste-next.description: Paste the next queue item into the focused field

rotate-next.description: Put the next queue item on the system clipboard (global — works while other apps are focused)

toggle-armed.description: Arm or disarm sequential paste (bind at chrome://extensions/shortcuts)
